_sources_note: PARTIAL - research in progress (written incrementally). Early-vote 2026 figures from local press citing state election offices, Oct 30 - Nov 3 2026. Reporting order from AP Decision Notes + state law; margins filled as found. null = not found, never invented.

KY.order_notes: AP 2026: almost all counties post all absentee+early results in first report; most also include in-person Election Day votes in the first report (so first dump is largely complete-county, not pre-only). Fayette Co. posts absentee first, then early+ED as precincts deliver. 2024 first results 6:05pm ET, 50% at 8:15pm ET, 90% at 9:30pm ET. Mail absentee must be RECEIVED by 6pm local ED (no postmark grace). Western KY is Central time (closes 7pm ET).

early_vote_2026.party_split: Day 1 early in-person: 66,166 D / 60,793 R / 8,942 other (registration, uninformative in KY)
